meta.name: add-deltachat
meta.description: Add DeltaChat channel integration via @deltachat/stdio-rpc-server. Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge. Email-based messaging with end-to-end encryption.

copy.tagline: 通过 DeltaChat 集成加密邮件通信
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加端到端加密的邮件聊天功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate encrypted email messaging via DeltaChat
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add end-to-end encrypted email chat to your app

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以通过 DeltaChat 收发加密邮件消息，支持文件附件和群聊，并自动管理连接状态。
howto.when: 当用户通过 DeltaChat 应用向机器人邮箱发送消息时触发，或机器人启动时自动连接 IMAP/SMTP 服务器。

say.text: 帮我给 DeltaChat 群发一条消息
say.note: 向已连接的群组发送消息。

say.text: 设置我的 DeltaChat 头像
say.note: 发送图片并附上 /set-avatar 命令。

say.text: 检查 DeltaChat 连接状态

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can send and receive encrypted email messages via DeltaChat, supports file attachments and group chats, and automatically manages connection status.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a user sends a message to the bot's email via the DeltaChat app, or automatically on startup to connect to IMAP/SMTP servers.

say_en.text: Send a message to the DeltaChat group.
say_en.note: Sends a message to the connected group.
